create_aloha_environment: create an ALOHA robot Gym environment with a config name, base path, and max steps
create_image_controller: create an ImageController to subscribe to four compressed camera ROS topics and retrieve images
reset_aloha_env: reset the ALOHA environment with an optional instruction and move arms to home position
step_aloha_env: step the ALOHA environment by executing 14-dof joint actions on both robot arms
close_aloha_env: close the ALOHA environment and move robot arms to sleep position before shutdown
